title: 第两千零六十九章 真实还是虚幻第两千零六十八章 种仙观里观道缘
content_zh:
第两千零六十九章真实还是虚幻
乌木簪破音，“不可能，这怎么可能！”
它几乎，从罗冠发间跳起来。
道种萌发！
这气息。
没错，绝不会错，就是道种萌发。
可罗冠凭什么？别说道种刚凝聚，不过数个月而已，就他差点横死的经历，怎么看都没半点道缘。
这世界，什么时候变成了，它完全不懂的模样？
罗冠点头，“果然，簪兄看错了，罗某道缘甚是昌盛啊！”
乌木簪沉默。
大概……或许……真是如此。
总不能是因为，被个凡尘女子拒绝，就直接道种萌发了？
“咳！恭喜罗道友……”
罗冠微笑，“簪兄似乎客气了许多。”
乌木簪干笑，“哪里哪里，之前些许误会，是我心胸狭隘了，罗道友勿怪。”
好道兵能屈能伸。
更何况道种萌发，罗冠注定将踏入第十境，成为位格中一员。
对他低头，不丢人。
三年后。
山下镇上，赵员外家里闹祟，命人请了种仙观道长前去做法事。

“徒弟，你跟贫道一起去，到了那听老夫吩咐，记下没？”观主老道比三年前，明显老了几分，此时一脸认真。
罗冠拱手，“是，师尊。”
师徒下山来到赵家，赵员外亲自相迎，态度热切，“老道长，您终于来了，近日家中不宁，可全都拜托您了。”
老道一挥拂尘，仙风道骨，“员外放心，贫道今日前来，定还家中一份清明。”
他侧身，“这是吾徒罗冠，随老夫修习多年，此番一起下山，日后还请赵家照拂一二。”
赵员外连连拱手，“老道长言重了，名师出高徒，您这位弟子一看，就不是凡俗。”
罗冠拱手道谢。
日头偏西，赵府明显冷清下去，活动行走的下人，都躲进了房里。
明明还有日头，可总觉得一股湿冷。
赵员外颤着声音，“老道长感觉到了吗？赵某家中，尽数拜托了！”说罢匆匆离去。
嘭！
院门关闭。
这后宅庭院中，就只剩下师徒两个。
老道看了看天，又环顾一圈，忍不住嘀咕，“这次，说不定还真有点东西。”
“徒弟，你怕不怕？”
罗冠拱手，“有师尊在，弟子不怕。”
老道大笑，“哈哈哈！你小子，倒是会说话，那今日老夫就好好，给你露一手。”
他面现得色，“咱们种仙观，虽没正统修行法门，但一些手段还是有的，区区邪祟不值一提。”
“徒弟，快快准备，将那黑狗、大公鸡带来！”
取了狗血、鸡血，混合入墨老道一阵笔走龙蛇，画了十几张符，吩咐罗冠张贴在院子各处。

又摆了坛，烧了黄纸，一坛雄黄酒洒在地上，围城一个圈，“徒弟进来！今日老夫教你一招，邪祟之流防不胜防，多有些诡异手段，咱们做法救人先护己身，不可中了算计。”
咳！
他压低声音，“若万一惹到大麻烦，咱们不是对手，躲在这坛上也可保得安稳。”
content_en:
Chapter 2069: Reality or Illusion?
Ebony Hairpin broke his voice, "Impossible, how is this possible!"
It almost jumped from Luo Guan's hair.
Taoism sprouts!
This breath.
That's right, it's absolutely true, it's the germination of Taoism.
But why does Luo Guan? Not to mention that Taoism had just been condensed, but it had only been a few months. His experience of almost dying suddenly showed that he had no Taoism at all.
When did this world become something it doesn’t understand at all?
Luo Guan nodded, "Sure enough, Brother Hairpin was wrong. Luo's destiny is very prosperous!"
The ebony hairpin was silent.
Probably...maybe...that's really the case.
It couldn't be that just because he was rejected by a mortal woman, the Tao seed sprouted?
"Ahem! Congratulations to Fellow Daoist Luo..."
Luo Guan smiled, "Brother Hairpin seems to be a lot more polite."
Ebony Hairpin smiled dryly, "No, no, there was some misunderstanding before. I am narrow-minded. Don't blame me, Fellow Daoist Luo."
A good Taoist soldier can bend and stretch.
What's more, when the Tao seed sprouts, Luo Guan is destined to enter the tenth realm and become a member of the realm.
There is no shame in bowing to him.
Three years later.
In the town at the foot of the mountain, there was trouble at Zhao's house, so he ordered the Taoist priest of Zhongxianguan to come and perform rituals.
"Apprentice, you go with the poor Taoist. When you get there, listen to my instructions. Do you remember?" The master of the temple, the old Taoist, is obviously a bit older than three years ago, and his face is serious now.
Luo Guan cupped his hands and said, "Yes, Master."
The master and apprentice came down the mountain to Zhao's house. Zhao Yuanwai personally greeted him with an eager attitude, "Old Taoist Master, you are finally here. I have been uneasy at home recently, so I can leave everything to you."
The old Taoist waved his fly whisk and said with a fairy-like tone, "Don't worry, I am here today. I will definitely give my family a piece of Qingming."
He turned sideways and said, "This is my disciple Luo Guan. He has practiced with me for many years. We are going down the mountain together this time. I will ask the Zhao family to take care of me in the future."
Zhao Yuanwai repeatedly raised his hand and said, "The old Taoist leader is serious. Famous teachers give birth to great disciples. At first glance, your disciple is no ordinary person."
Luo Guan cupped his hands and thanked him.
As the sun turned to the west, the Zhao Mansion became obviously deserted, and the servants who were walking around hid in their rooms.
There is still sunshine, but I always feel damp and cold.
Zhao Yuanwai's voice trembled, "Does the old Taoist priest feel it? Please help me from Zhao's house!" After that, he hurriedly left.
Bang!
The courtyard door is closed.
There were only two masters and apprentices left in the courtyard of the back house.
The old Taoist looked at the sky, then looked around, and couldn't help but mutter, "This time, maybe there is something."
"Apprentice, are you afraid?"
Luo Guan cupped his hands and said, "As long as the master is here, the disciples are not afraid."
The old Taoist laughed, "Hahaha! You are good at talking, so I will show you my skills today."
His face turned bright, "We cultivate immortality. Although we don't have orthodox cultivation methods, we still have some methods. The evil spirits are not worth mentioning."
"Apprentice, get ready quickly and bring the black dog and the big rooster!"
He took dog blood and chicken blood and mixed them with Mo Laodao. He drew more than a dozen talismans and ordered Luo Guan to post them all over the yard.
Another altar was set up, yellow paper was burned, a jar of realgar wine was sprinkled on the ground, and a circle was formed around the city. "Apprentice, come in! Today I will teach you a trick. It is difficult to guard against evil spirits, and there are many weird methods. We should save others and protect ourselves first. Don't fall into the trap."
Cough!
He lowered his voice and said, "If we get into big trouble, we are no match and we can stay safe just by hiding in this altar."
